description: Makes two takes of a song on Suno V6, each an MP3 with cover art, a title and the lyrics as sung. Modes: Describe (prompt is one sentence about the song; lyrics are written for you), Lyrics (prompt is your lyrics, with [Verse] [Chorus] [Bridge] tags), Instrumental (prompt describes the sound). 60 credits a run; needs TANVO_API_KEY.

save_to.description: Optional folder to download the results into (defaults to TANVO_OUTPUT_DIR when set)

style.description: Genre, instruments, tempo, voice, e.g. 'acoustic pop, hand claps, warm female vocal'

vocal.description: Lean towards a male or female voice (Lyrics mode)

wait.description: Wait for the songs (usually about a minute)

name: generate_music
title: Write a song
